extraction.scope: accepted top-level command tokens, aliases, help-discoverable subcommands and flags

count_note: The frozen dispatcher accepts 174 distinct top-level tokens. Sixteen have no canonical Usage/help contract because they are private diagnostics, implementation helpers, internal transport entrypoints, or explicitly help-hidden compatibility hooks; excluding those produces the requested/source-supported 158 public commands. Hidden commands remain cataloged.
